title: It was $40, so expectations shouldn't be high
text:
It was $40, so expectations shouldn't be high. The knob for the door is the highest quality piece, very heavy duty feel. Seriously.
The top and legs are solid pieces of wood, however the sides and back are panels, and feel cheap.
The door is also wood.
Overall it gets a 3 star because it there's some 1 star pieces and 5 star pieces on this night stand.
It was $40 so it did meet my expectation as that's not much for an end table

description: This wood shaker style accent table or nightstand is perfect for any room's decor. Table has one open storage, enclosed cabinet with metal door knob. Table assembled size is 18.9"W x 15"D x 25"H.

Drawing on the simple elegance of Shaker-style furniture, this versatile end table/night stand combines economy and grace. The solid beechwood unit features an oversized top surface, an open shelf, and a roomy storage cabinet. Proving that less is sometimes more, the single door hosts a plain inset panel and a brushed metal pull as its only decorations, while the tapered legs add a delicate counterpoint. Wood nailhead accents finish the piece with a handmade look and feel. Winsome Wood offers this stand in a Black or Natural finish. It measures 19 inches wide by 15 inches deep by 25 inches high; some assembly is required.
